summary: Describes the fixed elements of RFC documents, including title page header, boilerplates, and copyright statements, and updates them for current needs. It also helps handle the separate RFC publication streams. It is informational and was replaced by RFC 7841.

eli5.summary: Every RFC begins with a standard label and legal note, like the front cover of a book. This document explains what goes on the cover and why. It was replaced by RFC 7841.

questions: what is in an rfc header and boilerplate
